disposition: deputies reached her by phone; she refused to come out
summary: A caller told deputies his mother was armed with a firearm and that he believed she was preparing to use it, while a 2-year-old and a 4-year-old were with her. Deputies reached her by phone but she refused to come down, and children could be heard crying in the background.
A traffic unit was requested for a rollover at 23rd Street and Chester Avenue.

disposition: light smoke showing; command passed to a second battalion
summary: Crews found light smoke showing at a building fire and passed command to a second battalion while they worked it.

disposition: two patients reported; air and sheriff's units canceled
summary: A white Toyota and a pickup truck pulling a large trailer crashed. Dispatchers worked out how many people were hurt before an air ambulance and sheriff's units were canceled, and CHP kept the scene.
A crew was sent for a toddler with heavy bleeding from the head. The caller said a chair had fallen on the child but could not say how it happened.
CHP followed a GMC utility that failed to stop near Wible Road and Brundage Lane.
Officers were sent to check on a man in an older model car in the 1300 block of California Avenue.
Deputies issued a be-on-the-lookout for an adult reported missing in the valley, described as having the capacity of an 11-year-old.

disposition: man refused to come out; two juveniles in the room with him
summary: Officers were sent to a home where a man was reported to be in a back room with two juveniles barricaded with him. He had said his 12-year-old daughter let someone into the house, and he refused to come out until officers were there.
An open line came in from a home where a woman could be heard saying she had been hit.
Officers were sent after a caller reported a man doing donuts in a Mustang with a firearm tucked into his waistband.
Officers searched for a young girl who was playing outside an apartment complex in the 800 block of Beardsley Avenue and could not be found.

disposition: four patients; three ambulances and air support called
summary: A crash at a park left at least four people hurt, two of them tagged black, and a child's legs were pinned under the front of a vehicle. Three ambulances were called and crews asked for air support.

disposition: juvenile party; man with a knife reported
summary: Officers were sent to a fight in the 5500 block of College Avenue where juveniles had been drinking and adults were reported to have supplied the alcohol. One man was reported to have a knife.

disposition: woman with a knife jumped a fence onto church property
summary: Officers were sent to a weapons call on North Chester Avenue where a woman with a knife was reported to have jumped a fence onto church property.

disposition: caller reported he was the victim
summary: Officers were sent to a report of an attempted robbery where the caller described a man with a knife.
Officers were sent to a domestic call in the 900 block of Lake Street where a man was refusing to leave.

area: the 2600 block of Mount Vernon Avenue
summary: Officers and a fire crew responded to a panic alarm at a restaurant in the 2600 block of Mount Vernon Avenue.

disposition: woman in custody; crews staged for a reported stabbing
summary: Officers took a woman into custody who was reported to still be carrying knives, and fire crews staged nearby for a reported stabbing.

disposition: about 150 vehicles in a parking lot
summary: About 150 vehicles were reported doing donuts in a parking lot on Niles Street.
Officers were sent to a store after a caller reported a robbery and made threats.
A caller reported a woman hanging out of the window of a dark car while a man hit her and the car swerved in the 3700 block of Rosedale Highway.
A man with a handgun threatened to shoot a caller and then ran east on foot.
A vehicle went off an embankment near the southbound highway at the Golden State Avenue ramp.
Officers were sent to a physical fight involving four people in the 600 block of Airport Drive.
Officers were sent to a party that had grown to about 400 people.
Deputies were sent to check on a woman reported to be lying on the ground and bleeding.
CHP followed a Lexus that failed to stop, northbound on Highway 99 north of Panama Lane.

disposition: subject locked in a restroom; mental health call
summary: Officers were sent to a hospital emergency room lobby where a person had locked themselves in a restroom and appeared to be in a mental health crisis.
Deputies were sent to a fight between a man and a woman in front of a home in the 500 block of Woodrow Avenue, and two more people were reported to have joined in.

disposition: caller said someone hit a woman
summary: A caller reported a loud argument and a woman crying, and said someone had hit a woman.
Deputies were sent to a report of people taking fuel from underground storage on Edison Highway, with a van parked over the manhole cover.

disposition: seven people and more than 15 vehicles
summary: Officers were sent to a large fight involving seven people and more than 15 vehicles at McArthur Drive.
Deputies were sent to a possible altercation on Eucalyptus Drive just east of Fairfax Road.

disposition: head injury reported; medical aid requested
summary: A caller reported he had been hit and asked for medical aid for a head injury.

disposition: several parked cars hit; argument reported
summary: A vehicle hit several parked cars in the 600 block of Washington Avenue, and an argument was reported afterward.
Crews and officers responded to an overdose at a park.
Officers were sent to a domestic call at an apartment in the 600 block of Monterey Street.

disposition: five shots heard; a car left after the gunfire
summary: Callers reported about five gunshots in the 1800 block of Hendricks Lane. A four-door car was seen driving away, and a witness saw four or five people get out of it and go into a home at the end of a cul-de-sac.
A truck rolled over on Sierra Highway south of a county road, and crews reported the occupants were out of the vehicle.
CHP worked a collision at Browning Road and Elmo Highway in Tehachapi.

disposition: large party; caller said his father was shot; nobody found in the yard
summary: Officers were sent to a large party after a caller said his father had been shot, with a report of a victim down in the backyard. Multiple callers reported gunshots, and officers found no one in the yard.
Officers were sent to a fight between two people at an apartment.
A driver was rear-ended and pushed off the roadway on Highway 119 west of Tupman.
A caller reported a loud argument and a woman asking for help while a man followed her.
CHP responded to a white vehicle off the shoulder of the highway.
No collision found at Sloan and Guiness.
Commercial fire alarm at Union Villa kitchen.
